mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the seven king makers headed by the Bashorun."
Oyemesi is the seven king makers headed by the Bashorun.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the religious leader of his people, whose duty is to ensure that commandments of Allah are obeyed in his territory."
Religious Affairs The Emir is the religious leader of his people, whose duty is to ensure that commandments of Allah are obeyed in his territory.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a universal process and must exist in any organisation set up for a defined purpose or objective."
Administration is a universal process and must exist in any organisation set up for a defined purpose or objective.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the name of the kings (or mai, as they called themselves) of the Kanem-Bornu Empire, centred first in Kanem in western Chad, and then, after 1380, in Borno (today north-eastern Nigeria)."

Sayfawa dynasty or more properly Sayfawa dynasty is the name of the kings (or mai, as they called themselves) of the Kanem-Bornu Empire, centred first in Kanem in western Chad, and then, after 1380, in Borno (today north-eastern Nigeria).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to themselves as Nupecizi (Plural) and Nupeci (Singular)."
The Nupe people refer to themselves as Nupecizi (Plural) and Nupeci (Singular).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an extension of the world of the living, and the supernatural power is part of the Nigerian system of thought."
The world of ancestors is an extension of the world of the living, and the supernatural power is part of the Nigerian system of thought.
fib: ______ means beliefs or customs handed down from the past to the present or posterity.
Tradition means beliefs or customs handed down from the past to the present or posterity.
______ is the largest ethnic group in Northern Nigeria and by extension the whole country.
Hausa is the largest ethnic group in Northern Nigeria and by extension the whole country.
______ is made up of an agrarian population, where the economy and social life revolve round agriculture.
Nupe Occupations Nupe land is made up of an agrarian population, where the economy and social life revolve round agriculture.
______ are known as great merchants and traders, whose trading have taken them to various part of the Bini and Yoruba kingdom.
The Bini people are known as great merchants and traders, whose trading have taken them to various part of the Bini and Yoruba kingdom.
______ is defined as the complex whole that consists of all the ways we think and do and everything we have as members of society.
Culture is defined as the complex whole that consists of all the ways we think and do and everything we have as members of society.
